is_anopheles.evidence: The study tested Anopheles gambiae s.s. laboratory colony (VKPer) and field-collected Anopheles gambiae s.s. (M-form) from Ladji, Benin (page 2, 'Mosquitoes').

reports_target_markers.evidence: No genotyping was performed in this study. The authors only cited previous literature stating that the VKPer colony and the Ladji field population carry the kdr mutation (page 2, 'Mosquitoes').

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No genotype or allele counts, sample sizes, or frequencies for any resistance marker are reported.

african_field_population.evidence: Field mosquitoes were reared from larvae and pupae collected from breeding sites near Ladji, Benin in April 2009 (page 2, 'Mosquitoes').

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary research article investigating the synergistic efficacy of entomopathogenic fungi and permethrin against An. gambiae.

sub_country_location.evidence: Larval collection occurred in Ladji, Benin (6°23'23"N, 2°25'56"E) (page 2, 'Mosquitoes').

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Field mosquitoes were collected in April 2009 (page 2, 'Mosquitoes').

duplicate_risk.evidence: Routine field collection for experimental bioassays conducted by the authors.

supplement.evidence: No supplementary files are required; the study did not conduct molecular marker genotyping.

assessment.summary: This laboratory study evaluated the synergy between entomopathogenic fungi (Beauveria bassiana and Metarhizium anisopliae) and permethrin on resistant Anopheles gambiae s.s. (VKPer colony and field-collected mosquitoes from Ladji, Benin). Although bioassays were performed, no molecular genotyping of insecticide resistance markers was conducted.
exclusion_reasons: reports_target_markers: No resistance marker genotyping was performed; kdr presence was merely assumed from previous literature.
reports_extractable_genotype_data: No extractable genotype or allele counts/frequencies are presented.
